description.narrative:
The goal of the project is to reduce corruption in Armenia by revealing mechanisms of corruption and contributing to development of effective mechanisms to fight corruption, to improve the work of anti-corruption bodies by showing their shortcomings and gaps, to highlight existing problems in the field of human rights protection and help relevant bodies to solve them.
Objective 1. To contribute to the transparent and accountable governance through corruption reporting.
Objective 2. To contribute to the protection of human rights through reporting the violations of these rights.
Objective 3. Enhance professional capacities of thirty young journalists in investigative reporting.
Objective 4. To stimulate public discussion about corruption, human rights, and the rule of law.

Målet med projektet är att minska korruptionen i Armenien genom att avslöja korruptionsmekanismer och bidra till utvecklingen av effektiva mekanismer för att bekämpa korruption, att förbättra arbetet i anti-korruptionsorgan genom att visa deras brister och luckor, för att belysa befintliga problem på området mänskliga rättigheter och hjälpa relevanta organ att lösa dem.

The goal of the project is to reduce corruption in Armenia by revealing mechanisms of corruption and contributing to development of effective mechanisms to fight corruption, to improve the work of anti-corruption bodies by showing their shortcomings and gaps, to highlight existing problems in the field of human rights protection and help relevant bodies to solve them.

Based on Hetq publications, 20 judicial proceedings were initiated by various law enforcement agencies - National Security Service, Court Enforcement Service, Food Safety Inspection Body, Anti-Corruption Committee, Prosecutor's Office, etc. Some of the proceedings completed with administrative fines against various officials. In 2023, at least 8 of the cases being examined in the Anti-Corruption Court with the demand for the confiscation of illegal property are based on the findings of Hetq.
Hetq journalistic articles contributed to raising public awareness about corruption and human rights violations. The editorial team received 132 requests from citizens asking Hetq to address issues of concern to them when it comes to violation of their rights. The materials on human rights violations covered various areas, including the right to a fair trial, environmental rights, property rights, telecommunications rights, labor rights.
In 2023 annual report of the Prosecutor's Office, the legal processes initiated after Hetq's 7 publications were included. Hetq's investigative journalists were invited to an off the record meeting between the Prosecutor General and journalists, during which the Prosecutor General highly praised Hetq's work, noting that these investigations helped the law enforcement agencies.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
